forbidden: an admin, owner, vendor, order, payment, or role cookie created by the static Vite client
document.cookie, Cookie Store API, or custom Set-Cookie handling
analytics, advertising, fingerprinting, replay, or cross-site tracking cookies
customer, order, vendor identity, vendor pricing, sourcing, margin, credential, webhook, or Stripe data in cookies
deploying the local owner UI and treating a client-created cookie as remote authentication
notes: The current owner/admin UI is local-only and has no verified authenticated backend.
The isolated payment Worker is API-only and must not serve the owner UI or own an admin browser session.
A future loopback backend may add a short-lived session only after server-side identity, CSRF, revocation, audit, and no-store behavior are implemented.
